### Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [**CONTRIBUTING.md**](https://github.com/Siroopfles/NovaPort/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) document.
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project. I have run `./scripts/format.sh` locally before committing.
